cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative open-loop moment accumulation: uncompensated -6 kNm, constant yaw inertia 3000 kg m2, zero initial yaw-rate and heading increments. After 50,100,200 ms, yaw-rate magnitudes are 5.73,11.46,22.92 degrees/s and heading magnitudes .143,.573,2.292 degrees. No tyre response or closed-loop trajectory is modeled; these values are not safety thresholds.
